$comment: TASK-075 (TRD-206, Q7): which runner applies each chain of scripts/migrations/ranges.json, and so who takes the pre-migration dump. Must cover ranges.json exactly (suite.mjs). tenant-store: packages/tenant-store runMigrations with the dump hook (cli.ts migrate). legacy-boot: the kernel's boot/db.ts runners; gremion-migration-dump preflight takes the host-side dump (Q11). module-upgrade: the module-upgrade step of a release. unadopted: no runner here dumps yet; a new file needs -- gremion:manual-dump <runbook step>. An adopter flips its chain's class.

classes.tenant-store: packages/tenant-store runMigrations; cli.ts migrate composes TASK-029's chainPreApply and the dump hook
classes.legacy-boot: gremion-ui db.ts / control-migrations.ts via the migrate service; gremion-migration-dump preflight takes the host-side dump
classes.module-upgrade: applied by the module-upgrade --all verb of the tenant-create one-shot (tenant-store upgradeModuleDatabase) to the enable-gate database of every customer that has the module enabled, after a host dump set of the same release and before the new colour starts. A new file still needs -- gremion:manual-dump <runbook step>: gremion-deploy, upgrade.sh and a hand upgrade run no such step and take no module dump. A leaf-backed module's own databases are not in its scope: the leaf migrates them itself
classes.unadopted: no runner in this repo dumps the database yet; module-board has no customer database and mail has no chain files, so no step applies them; a new file needs -- gremion:manual-dump <runbook step>
classes.fresh-only: applied by packages/tenant-store runMigrations through migrateGovernanceDatabase, only on a database created in the same step: nothing to lose, so no dump and no manual-dump marker; flips to tenant-store together with the governance-migrate runner, before any 0002 (TASK-084-a)
